<!--
Analysis code for the results section 'Timing of colibactin mutagenesis' in
Marshall et al., "Common early-life exposure of the colorectal epithelium to
the microbiome-derived mutagen colibactin".

Branches of each crypt phylogeny are annotated by signature attribution, and
the background mutation clock is used to convert branch start/end points into
donor ages. From these, timepoints of commencement, continuation and cessation
of colibactin exposure are derived.

The same pipeline is run twice: once on the paediatric cohort and once on the
adult cohort of Lee-Six et al., Nature, 2019. In the original notebook that
meant the whole script was copy-pasted, with the second copy silently
overwriting the objects created by the first. Here every step is a function
defined once in "Shared pipeline" below, and each run writes to its own
`paed_*` / `lee_six_*` objects.
-->

# Shared pipeline

Every function below is used by both the paediatric and the Lee-Six run. The
cohort-specific differences are passed in as arguments and are listed, with the
values used, in the two run sections that follow.

## Branch sensitivity

A branch is detectable if at least one descendant crypt is detectable, so
sensitivity propagates up the tree as `1 - prod(1 - sens_children)`.

```{r fn-compute-branch-sens}
compute_branch_sens <- function(tree, tip_sens) {
  n_tip  <- Ntip(tree)
  n_node <- tree$Nnode
  sens   <- rep(NA_real_, n_tip + n_node)

  # tip sensitivities, in the tree's own tip order
  sens[seq_len(n_tip)] <- tip_sens[tree$tip.label, 1]

  edges <- reorder.phylo(tree, "postorder")$edge

  # postorder guarantees that every child is reached before its parent
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(edges))) {
    parent   <- edges[i, 1]
    children <- edges[edges[, 1] == parent, 2]

    if (all(!is.na(sens[children]))) {
      sens[parent] <- 1 - prod(1 - sens[children])
    }
  }

  sens  # indexed by node number
}
```

## Crypt pileup

For each crypt, walk from its tip to the root and stack the branches it passes
through. The result is one row per crypt per ancestral branch.

```{r fn-crypt-pileup}
# Collect the branches on the path from one tip back to the root.
walk_to_root <- function(tree_df, crypt_label) {
  current <- tree_df[which(tree_df$label == crypt_label & !is.na(tree_df$label)), ]
  path    <- current

  while (current$node != current$parent) {
    current <- tree_df[tree_df$node == current$parent, ]
    path    <- rbind(path, current)
  }

  path
}

# Build the pileup across every patient tree in `tree_dir`, together with the
# per-branch sensitivities. Patients without a tree file are skipped.
build_crypt_pileup <- function(tree_dir, tip_sens, crypt_pattern = "PD|HLS|O|\\_") {
  patients   <- list.files(tree_dir)
  pileups    <- list()
  sens_edges <- list()

  for (patient in patients) {
    tree_file <- file.path(tree_dir, patient,
                           paste0(patient, ".tree_with_branch_length.tree"))
    if (!file.exists(tree_file)) next

    tree     <- read.tree(tree_file)
    sens_vec <- compute_branch_sens(tree, tip_sens)

    sens_edges[[patient]] <- as.data.frame(tree$edge) %>%
      setNames(c("parent", "child")) %>%
      left_join(tibble(child = seq_along(sens_vec), sens = sens_vec), by = "child") %>%
      mutate(
        sens    = replace_na(sens, 1),
        Samples = paste0(patient, "_", child)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(Samples, sens)

    tree_df <- ggtree::fortify(tree)

    crypts <- tree_df$label %>%
      unique() %>%
      discard(is.na) %>%
      keep(~ str_detect(.x, crypt_pattern))

    pileups[[patient]] <- map_dfr(
      crypts,
      ~ walk_to_root(tree_df, .x) %>% mutate(crypt = .x)
    )
  }

  list(
    pileup     = bind_rows(pileups),
    sens_edges = bind_rows(sens_edges)
  )
}
```

## Sensitivity-adjusted branch attributions

```{r fn-adjust-attributions}
adjust_attributions <- function(crypt_branch, branch_attributions, sens_edges) {
  crypt_branch %>%
    left_join(branch_attributions, by = c("branch_id" = "X_branch")) %>%
    left_join(sens_edges,          by = c("branch_id" = "Samples")) %>%
    mutate(sens = replace_na(sens, 1)) %>%
    # branches with no attribution carry no mutations of that signature.
    # Restricted to numeric columns; the original applied this to every column,
    # which would have coerced any missing crypt or branch identifier to "0".
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
    mutate(
      across(contains("SBS"), ~ round(.x, digits = 3)),
      across(contains("SBS"), ~ .x / sens)
    )
}
```

## Branch annotation and the background mutation clock

<!--
NOTE: `x` below is the ggtree `fortify()` column giving cumulative distance
from the root, so `branch.length <= 50 & x < 50` identifies short truncal
branches. It reads like a stray variable but is deliberate.
-->

```{r fn-annotate-branches}
annotate_branches <- function(pileup, attributions, join_by) {
  left_join(pileup, attributions, by = join_by) %>%
    mutate(
      # unattributed branches, typically at the root
      across(contains("SBS"), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)),
      muts_assigned = rowSums(pick(contains("_branch"))),
      # rescale if the attribution exceeds the branch length
      across(contains("_branch"),
             ~ if_else(muts_assigned > branch.length,
                       (.x / muts_assigned) * branch.length, .x)),
      # zero out short truncal branches
      across(contains("_branch"), ~ if_else(branch.length <= 50 & x < 50, 0, .x)),
      SBSUnassigned = branch.length - rowSums(pick(contains("_branch")))
    ) %>%
    arrange(crypt, x) %>%
    group_by(crypt) %>%
    # background clock for this branch, and cumulative totals along the lineage
    mutate(
      background_muts_branch = SBS1_branch + SBS5_branch + SBS18_branch + SBSUnassigned
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      background_muts_branch_end_msa   = cumsum(background_muts_branch),
      background_muts_branch_start_msa = background_muts_branch_end_msa - background_muts_branch
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      all_muts_count_branch_end_msa  = cumsum(background_muts_branch + SBS88_branch),
      background_muts_crypt_total_msa = sum(background_muts_branch)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```

## Confidence intervals on branch points

Each branch point is placed by the number of background mutations preceding it.
A Poisson test of that count against the crypt's total background burden gives
the interval.

```{r fn-poisson-ci}
poisson_ci <- function(count, total) {
  count <- round(count, digits = 0)
  total <- round(total, digits = 0)

  ci <- vapply(
    seq_along(count),
    function(i) poisson.test(count[i], total[i])$conf.int * total[i],
    numeric(2)
  )

  t(ci)
}

add_branch_cis <- function(df) {
  start_ci <- poisson_ci(df$background_muts_branch_start_msa,
                         df$background_muts_crypt_total_msa)
  end_ci   <- poisson_ci(df$background_muts_branch_end_msa,
                         df$background_muts_crypt_total_msa)

  df %>%
    mutate(
      background_muts_branch_start_lower_ci = start_ci[, 1],
      background_muts_branch_start_upper_ci = start_ci[, 2],
      background_muts_branch_end_lower_ci   = end_ci[, 1],
      background_muts_branch_end_upper_ci   = end_ci[, 2]
    )
}
```

## Per-crypt background mutation rate

```{r fn-background-rates}
# `age_key` is the column linking a crypt to a donor age: "biopsy" for the
# paediatric cohort, "patient" for Lee-Six.
background_rates <- function(df, age_lookup, age_key) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(age_key), crypt, background_muts_crypt_total_msa) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    left_join(age_lookup, by = age_key) %>%
    mutate(background_muts_rate_msa = background_muts_crypt_total_msa / age) %>%
    dplyr::select(crypt, background_muts_rate_msa, age)
}
```

## Branch classification

<!--
NOTE: `SBS88_unpruned` is NA for branches absent from the unpruned attribution
table. The original behaviour is preserved: such a branch fails the "Post
cessation branch" test and falls through to "Indeterminant" whenever its length
is below `indeterminant_max_length`.
-->

```{r fn-classify-branches}
classify_branches <- function(df, unpruned, rates,
                              post_cessation_min_length,
                              indeterminant_max_length) {
  df %>%
    left_join(unpruned, by = c("branch_id" = "Sample_unpruned")) %>%
    group_by(crypt) %>%
    mutate(
      parent_branch_id = paste0(patient, "_", parent),
      branch_status = case_when(
        branch.length <= 50 & x < 50
          ~ "Truncal",
        sum(SBS88_branch > 0) == 0
          ~ "Negative Crypt",
        sum(SBS88_branch > 0) > 0 & cumsum(SBS88_branch > 0) == 0
          ~ "Pre exposure",
        cumsum(SBS88_branch > 0) == 1 & SBS88_branch > 0
          ~ "First positive branch",
        cumsum(SBS88_branch > 0) > 1 & SBS88_branch > 0
          ~ "Second positive branch",
        cumsum(SBS88_branch > 0) > 0 & SBS88_branch == 0 &
          SBS88_unpruned == 0 & branch.length > post_cessation_min_length
          ~ "Post cessation branch",
        cumsum(SBS88_branch > 0) > 0 & SBS88_branch == 0 &
          (SBS88_unpruned > 0 | branch.length < indeterminant_max_length)
          ~ "Post cessation branch - Indeterminant",
        TRUE
          ~ "other"
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    left_join(rates, by = "crypt") %>%
    # convert mutation counts into donor ages using the per-crypt clock
    mutate(
      across(contains("background_muts_branch"),
             ~ .x / background_muts_rate_msa, .names = "age_{.col}"),
      branch_duration = age_background_muts_branch_end_msa -
                        age_background_muts_branch_start_msa
    )
}
```

## Timepoints and swimmer-plot data

```{r fn-timepoints}
# Reshape classified branches into one row per crypt per informative timepoint.
# `branch_statuses` selects which branch types contribute; `informative`
# selects the timepoints a crypt must have at least one of to be retained.
build_timepoints <- function(df, branch_statuses, informative) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      patient, crypt, branch_id, parent_branch_id, branch_status,
      age_background_muts_branch_start_msa,
      age_background_muts_branch_end_msa, age
    ) %>%
    filter(branch_status %in% branch_statuses) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = contains("age")) %>%
    mutate(
      timepoint = case_when(
        branch_status == "First positive branch" &
          name == "age_background_muts_branch_start_msa" ~ "age_earliest_commencement",
        branch_status == "First positive branch" &
          name == "age_background_muts_branch_end_msa"   ~ "age_latest_commencement",
        branch_status == "Second positive branch" &
          name == "age_background_muts_branch_start_msa" ~ "age_continuation",
        branch_status == "Post cessation branch" &
          name == "age_background_muts_branch_start_msa" ~ "age_cessation",
        branch_status == "Post cessation branch - Indeterminant" &
          name == "age_background_muts_branch_start_msa" ~ "age_indeterminant_timepoint",
        branch_status == "First positive branch" &
          name == "age"                                  ~ "donor_age",
        .default = "Other"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(timepoint != "Other") %>%
    dplyr::select(patient, crypt, timepoint, value) %>%
    group_by(crypt) %>%
    # keep only crypts with at least one informative timepoint
    filter(sum(timepoint %in% informative) > 0) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```


```{r fn-swimmer-data}
build_swimmer_data <- function(timepoints, limit_repeat_timepoints = FALSE) {
  patient_order <- timepoints %>%
    filter(timepoint == "donor_age") %>%
    group_by(patient) %>%
    summarise(donor_age = median(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(donor_age))

  crypt_order <- timepoints %>%
    distinct(crypt, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(patient_f = factor(patient, levels = patient_order$patient)) %>%
    arrange(patient_f) %>%
    group_by(patient_f) %>%
    mutate(ypos = seq(1.5, by = 0.5, length.out = n())) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(crypt, ypos)

  earliest_commencement <- timepoints %>%
    filter(timepoint == "age_earliest_commencement") %>%
    dplyr::select(crypt, age_earliest_commencement = value)

  bar <- timepoints %>%
    left_join(patient_order,         by = "patient") %>%
    left_join(crypt_order,           by = "crypt") %>%
    left_join(earliest_commencement, by = "crypt") %>%
    mutate(patient_f = factor(patient, levels = patient_order$patient)) %>%
    arrange(patient_f) %>%
    filter(!timepoint %in% c("donor_age", "age_latest_commencement")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
    dplyr::select(patient, patient_f, crypt, donor_age,
                  age_earliest_commencement, timepoint, value, ypos)

  if (limit_repeat_timepoints) {
    # at most one cessation per crypt, and no indeterminant timepoint after an
    # earlier indeterminant or cessation timepoint
    bar <- bar %>%
      group_by(crypt) %>%
      filter(
        cumsum(timepoint == "age_cessation") < 2 &
          !(timepoint == "age_indeterminant_timepoint" &
              cumsum(timepoint %in% c("age_indeterminant_timepoint", "age_cessation")) > 1)
      ) %>%
      ungroup()
  }

  bar %>% distinct(crypt, patient, timepoint, value, .keep_all = TRUE)
}
```

```{r fn-plot-elements}
segment_width     <- 1.7
```

## Shared summary helpers

<!--
NOTE: the original summaries used `max(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)` and
`min(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)`. The 0.75 was intended as a quantile argument
but was passed to max()/min() as an extra value, so every reported minimum was
capped at 0.75 and every maximum was at least 0.75. Corrected below -- the
reported minima in particular will change.
-->

```{r fn-summaries}
# Patient-level medians, then a cohort-level summary of those medians.
summarise_across_patients <- function(df, value_col = value, group_col) {
  df %>%
    group_by({{ group_col }}) %>%
    summarise(
      median = round(median({{ value_col }}, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      lwr    = round(quantile({{ value_col }}, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      upr    = round(quantile({{ value_col }}, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      min    = round(min({{ value_col }}, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      max    = round(max({{ value_col }}, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# Earliest and latest possible commencement, summarised across patients. The
# latest possible commencement is taken from the first informative timepoint.
summarise_commencement <- function(bar) {
  bar %>%
    group_by(patient) %>%
    filter(timepoint %in% c("age_cessation", "age_continuation")) %>%
    filter(value == min(value)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(patient, age_earliest_commencement, value) %>%
    dplyr::rename(latest_possible_commencement = value) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = contains("commencement")) %>%
    group_by(patient, name) %>%
    summarise(value = median(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
    summarise_across_patients(group_col = name)
}

# Continuation / cessation timepoints, summarised across patients.
# `patient_fn` is median for the paediatric cohort and min for Lee-Six.
summarise_timepoints <- function(bar, patient_fn = median) {
  bar %>%
    filter(timepoint %in% c("age_cessation", "age_continuation")) %>%
    dplyr::select(patient, timepoint, value) %>%
    group_by(patient, timepoint) %>%
    summarise(value = patient_fn(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
    summarise_across_patients(group_col = timepoint)
}
```

# Run 1: paediatric colon

## Input data

```{r paed-load}
crypt_signature_attributions <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "crypt_signature_attributions.csv")
)
crypt_metadata <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "biopsy_metadata.csv"))

# pruned per-branch SBS attributions
paed_branch_attributions <- read.csv(
  file.path("..", "Signatures", "msa_phylogenetic_branches_attribution",
            "pruned_attribution_paediatric_branches_SBS_abs_mutations.csv")
) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_branch"))

# unpruned attributions, used only to flag branches where SBS88 is present
# before pruning
paed_branch_unpruned <- read.csv(
  file.path("..", "Signatures", "msa_phylogenetic_branches_attribution",
            "output_paediatric_branches_SBS_weights_table.csv")
) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_unpruned")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample_unpruned, SBS88_unpruned)

paed_tip_sens <- crypt_signature_attributions %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, sensitivitySBS) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "sample")

paed_age_lookup <- crypt_metadata %>%
  dplyr::select(biopsy, age) %>%
  distinct()

stopifnot(!any(duplicated(paed_age_lookup$biopsy)))
```

## Crypt pileup

This chunk walks every tree and is the slowest step in the notebook; consider
setting `cache = TRUE` on it while iterating.

```{r paed-pileup}
paed_trees <- build_crypt_pileup(
  tree_dir = file.path("..", "snv_phylogenetic_trees"),
  tip_sens = paed_tip_sens
)

paed_pileup <- paed_trees$pileup %>%
  mutate(
    patient   = str_extract(crypt, "PD\\d{5}"),
    biopsy    = str_extract(crypt, "PD\\d{5}\\w"),
    branch_id = paste(patient, node, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  distinct(crypt, branch_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

## Sensitivity-adjusted attributions

```{r paed-attributions}
paed_attributions <- paed_pileup %>%
  dplyr::select(biopsy, crypt, branch_id) %>%
  adjust_attributions(paed_branch_attributions, paed_trees$sens_edges)
```

## Branch annotation and background clock

```{r paed-annotate}
paed_annotated <- paed_pileup %>%
  annotate_branches(paed_attributions, join_by = c("biopsy", "crypt", "branch_id")) %>%
  add_branch_cis()

paed_rates <- background_rates(paed_annotated, paed_age_lookup, age_key = "biopsy")
```

## Branch classification

Branch-length thresholds for the paediatric cohort: a post cessation branch must exceed  44 mutations.

```{r paed-classify}
paed_branch_classification <- classify_branches(
  paed_annotated,
  unpruned                  = paed_branch_unpruned,
  rates                     = paed_rates,
  post_cessation_min_length = 44,
  indeterminant_max_length  = 44
)

count(paed_branch_classification, branch_status)
```

```{r paed-write-classification}
write.csv(
  paed_branch_classification,
  file.path(data_dir, "phylogenetic_trees_branch_classification.csv"),
  quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)
```

## Timepoints and swimmer-plot data

```{r paed-timepoints}
paed_timepoints <- build_timepoints(
  paed_branch_classification,
  branch_statuses = c("First positive branch", "Second positive branch",
                      "Post cessation branch", "Post cessation branch - Indeterminant"),
  informative     = c("age_cessation", "age_indeterminant_timepoint", "age_continuation")
)

paed_bar_plot <- build_swimmer_data(paed_timepoints, limit_repeat_timepoints = TRUE)
```

## Figure 4: swimmer plot

```{r fig4-paed-swimmers, fig.width = 9.33, fig.height = 12}
paed_fill_breaks <- c("age_continuation", "age_cessation", "age_earliest_commencement",
                      "age_indeterminant_timepoint", "secondary_bifurcation")

paed_swimmers_plt <- ggplot(paed_bar_plot, aes(y = ypos)) +

  # full lifespan of the donor, as background
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = donor_age, yend = ypos),
               colour = background_colour, linewidth = segment_width) +

  # window of active exposure
  geom_segment(
    data = filter(paed_bar_plot, timepoint %in% c("age_continuation",
                                                  "age_indeterminant_timepoint",
                                                  "age_cessation")),
    aes(x = age_earliest_commencement, xend = value, yend = ypos),
    colour = exposure_colour, alpha = 1, linewidth = segment_width
  ) +

  # possible continuation beyond the last known positive branch
  geom_segment(
    data = filter(paed_bar_plot, timepoint == "age_continuation"),
    aes(x = value, xend = donor_age, yend = ypos),
    colour = exposure_colour, alpha = 0.3, linewidth = segment_width
  ) +

  # period after cessation
  geom_segment(
    data = filter(paed_bar_plot, timepoint == "age_cessation"),
    aes(x = value, xend = donor_age, yend = ypos),
    colour = background_colour, alpha = 1, linewidth = segment_width
  ) +

  # commencement / continuation / cessation markers
  geom_point(
    data = filter(paed_bar_plot, timepoint %in% paed_fill_breaks),
    aes(x = value, y = ypos, fill = timepoint),
    size = 3.5, colour = "black", shape = 23, alpha = 1, stroke = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    breaks = paed_fill_breaks,
    values = timepoint_colours,
    labels = timepoint_labels[paed_fill_breaks]
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks       = seq(0, 20, 5),
    minor_breaks = seq(0, 20, 1),
    expand       = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
  ) +
  facet_grid(patient_f ~ ., scales = "free", switch = "y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(y = "Colonic Crypts Grouped by Donor", x = "Window for exposure [years]") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y      = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y     = element_blank(),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.placement  = "inside",
    strip.text       = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "none",
    legend.title     = element_blank()
  )

paed_swimmers_plt

ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "crypt_by_crypt_swimmers_plot.png"),
  paed_swimmers_plt,
  width = 2800 / 300, height = 3600 / 300, dpi = 300, bg = "transparent"
)
```

### Standalone legend

```{r fig4-legend}
legend_df <- data.frame(
  colour = c("skyblue2", "springgreen2", "orange1", "grey75",
             exposure_colour, scales::alpha(exposure_colour, 0.5), background_colour),
  timepoint = c(
    "Earliest Possible Commencement of Exposure",
    "Timepoint of Ongoing Exposure",
    "Latest Possible Cessation of Exposure",

  ),

)

)
```

Ratio of continuation to cessation timepoints within age bands.

```{r paed-age-band-ratios}
age_bands <- c(0, 2, 5, 10, 15)

map_dfr(seq_len(length(age_bands) - 1), function(i) {
  lower <- age_bands[i]
  upper <- age_bands[i + 1]

  paed_bar_plot %>%
    filter(value > lower, value < upper,
           timepoint %in% c("age_continuation", "age_cessation")) %>%
    distinct(patient, value, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    count(timepoint, name = "n") %>%
    mutate(
      age_band = sprintf("%g-%g years", lower, upper),
      prop     = n / sum(n),
      ratio    = prop / (1 - prop)
    )
}) %>%
  dplyr::select(age_band, timepoint, n, prop, ratio)
```

Continuation and cessation timepoints by colonic side.

```{r paed-timepoints-by-side}
location_metadata <- crypt_metadata %>% dplyr::select(biopsy, site)

paed_bar_plot %>%
  mutate(biopsy = str_extract(crypt, "PD\\d{5}\\w")) %>%
  left_join(location_metadata, by = "biopsy") %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("age_continuation", "age_cessation",
                          "age_indeterminant_timepoint")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = c("Left", "Right"))) %>%
  group_by(site, timepoint) %>%
  distinct(value, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    timepoints = n(),
    median     = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    lower      = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    upper      = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    min        = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max        = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(median, lower, upper, min, max), ~ round(.x, 1)))
```

# Run 2: adult colon (Lee-Six et al., Nature, 2019)

The same pipeline, with four differences from Run 1:

## Input data

```{r lee-six-load}
lee_six_nature_2019 <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "lee_six_nature_2019_sbs_id_attribution.csv")
)

lee_six_crypt_patient_map <- lee_six_nature_2019 %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, crypt)

lee_six_branch_attributions <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "Lee_Six_Nature_2019", "msa_branch_attributions",
            "pruned_attribution_hls_branches_SBS_abs_mutations.csv")
) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_branch"))

lee_six_branch_unpruned <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "Lee_Six_Nature_2019", "msa_branch_attributions",
            "output_hls_branches_SBS_weights_table.csv")
) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_unpruned")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample_unpruned, SBS88_unpruned)

lee_six_tip_sens <- lee_six_nature_2019 %>%
  dplyr::select(crypt, sensitivitySBS) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "crypt")

lee_six_age_lookup <- lee_six_nature_2019 %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, age) %>%
  distinct()

stopifnot(!any(duplicated(lee_six_age_lookup$patient)))
```

## Crypt pileup

```{r lee-six-pileup}
lee_six_trees <- build_crypt_pileup(
  tree_dir = file.path(data_dir, "Lee_Six_Nature_2019", "snv_phylogenetics_output"),
  tip_sens = lee_six_tip_sens
)

lee_six_pileup <- lee_six_trees$pileup %>%
  left_join(lee_six_crypt_patient_map, by = "crypt") %>%
  mutate(branch_id = paste(patient, node, sep = "_")) %>%
  distinct(crypt, branch_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

## Attributions, annotation and classification

```{r lee-six-classify}
lee_six_attributions <- lee_six_pileup %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, crypt, branch_id) %>%
  adjust_attributions(lee_six_branch_attributions, lee_six_trees$sens_edges)

lee_six_annotated <- lee_six_pileup %>%
  annotate_branches(lee_six_attributions, join_by = c("patient", "crypt", "branch_id")) %>%
  add_branch_cis()

lee_six_rates <- background_rates(lee_six_annotated, lee_six_age_lookup, age_key = "patient")

lee_six_branch_classification <- classify_branches(
  lee_six_annotated,
  unpruned                  = lee_six_branch_unpruned,
  rates                     = lee_six_rates,
  post_cessation_min_length = 44,
  indeterminant_max_length  = 43
)

count(lee_six_branch_classification, branch_status)
```

## Timepoints and swimmer-plot data

```{r lee-six-timepoints}
lee_six_timepoints <- build_timepoints(
  lee_six_branch_classification,
  branch_statuses = c("First positive branch", "Second positive branch",
                      "Post cessation branch"),
  informative     = c("age_cessation", "age_continuation")
)

lee_six_bar_plot <- build_swimmer_data(lee_six_timepoints, limit_repeat_timepoints = FALSE)
```

# Indel burden by branch status

```{r indel-burdens}
indel_burdens <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "paediatric_id_branches.SBS83.all"))

indel_burdens_df <- data.frame(
  branch_id        = colnames(indel_burdens)[-1],
  branch_id_burden = colSums(indel_burdens[, -1])
)

branch_status_levels <- c("First positive branch", "Second positive branch",
                          "Post cessation branch", "Negative Crypt",
                          #'Post cessation branch - Indeterminant',
                          "Truncal", "Pre exposure")

indel_burdens_compare <- paed_branch_classification %>%
  left_join(indel_burdens_df, by = "branch_id") %>%
  mutate(
    branch_status=ifelse(branch_status=='Post cessation branch - Indeterminant','Post cessation branch',branch_status),
    branch_status = factor(branch_status, levels = branch_status_levels),
    id_rate       = branch_id_burden / branch_duration
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(branch_id, id_rate, branch_status) %>%
  filter(!is.na(id_rate), is.finite(id_rate)) %>%
  group_by(branch_id) %>%
  filter(id_rate == min(id_rate)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct()

count(indel_burdens_compare, branch_status)
```

```{r indel-tests}
comparisons <- list(
  c("Post cessation branch",  "Negative Crypt"),
  c("Second positive branch", "Post cessation branch"),
  c("Second positive branch", "Negative Crypt"),
  c("First positive branch",  "Post cessation branch"),
  c("First positive branch",  "Negative Crypt")
)

p_values <- map_dbl(comparisons, function(comp) {
  indel_burdens_compare %>%
    filter(branch_status %in% comp) %>%
    droplevels() %>%
    wilcox.test(id_rate ~ branch_status, data = .) %>%
    pluck("p.value")
})

p_adj <- p.adjust(p_values, method = "bonferroni")

tibble(
  comparison = map_chr(comparisons, ~ paste(.x, collapse = " vs ")),
  p_raw      = signif(p_values, 3),
  p_bonferroni = signif(p_adj, 3)
)
```

```{r supp-indel-by-branch-status, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6}
indel_branches_plt <- ggplot(
    filter(indel_burdens_compare, id_rate < 60),
    aes(x = branch_status, y = id_rate, fill = branch_status)
  ) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = comparisons,
    y_position  = c(29, 34, 39, 44, 49),
    annotations = if_else(p_adj < 0.001, "P < 0.001",
                          paste0("P = ", signif(p_adj, 3))),
    tip_length  = 0.01
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 60)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    breaks = branch_status_levels,
    values = c("maroon4", "hotpink3", "grey30", "grey70", "grey70", "grey70")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = branch_status_levels,
    labels = c("First positive\nbranch", "Second\npositive branch",
               "Post cessation\nbranch", "Negative\nCrypt",
               "Truncal", "Pre-exposure")
  ) +
  labs(y = "ID mutation rate [mutations / year]", x = "", fill = "Branch status") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text       = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 12)
  )

indel_branches_plt

ggsave(
  file.path(supp_fig_dir, "compare_indel_per_year.png"),
  indel_branches_plt,
  width = 9, height = 6
)
```
